entities.name: Moraug
entities.description: A ferocious minotaur warrior of Akoum on Zendikar who roams the wilds alone, with enormous horns.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Rugged region of Zendikar where Moraug lives.

events.summary: Moraug rejected society and roams the untamed wilds, hunting game or passing humanoids.
events.quote: Moraug has rejected any semblance of society and roams the untamed wilds instead

relations.note: A minotaur of the rugged region.
relations.quote: from the rugged region of Akoum on Zendikar
